posts.title: Introducing confingy
posts.description: I’m incredibly excited to finally introduce confingy to the world. GitHub: https://github.com/runwayml/confingy Docs: https://runwayml.github.io/confingy This is a library that solves a problem that I’ve had for over a decade at every company at which I’ve worked. The library is also the answer to my previous blog post, Why can’t we separate YAML from ML? . Major shoutout to my employer, Runway ,

posts.title: Stop talking about reproducibility
posts.description: I’m not saying reproducibility is an unworthy aspiration. I merely have issues with the word itself. It’s a misnomer that distracts from the real goals. You often hear about the need for “reproducible science”, or better yet, a “crisis of reproducibility” in science, particularly in the social sciences. Nobody really cares about whether somebody else can exactly rerun the same published experiment
